story.title: OpenAI adds 'Trusted Contact' safeguard to ChatGPT for users showing signs of self-harm
story.summary: OpenAI has introduced a new safety feature called 'Trusted Contact' for ChatGPT that activates when a conversation shows signs of a user potentially engaging in self-harm. The feature allows users to pre-designate a trusted person who can be notified in high-risk situations, extending OpenAI's existing crisis-intervention protocols. The rollout represents a significant expansion of platform-level duty-of-care obligations for consumer AI products.
